role: Abstract leaves: the decay BFS from the log distance field, the sapling and apple drop rolls, the shears harvest, and the biome foliage colour.

members.name: field_150128_a
members.note: one array per leaf block object (Blocks.leaves, Blocks.leaves2). A search rewrites the +-4 cube before reading it and never writes the +-5 shell it reads (0), so only its centre cell is computed (randomtick.c rt_leaves: a breadth-first search out from the leaf through leaves, the same shortest chain to a log); the centre cell, which updateTick reads even when checkChunksExist failed, is state: nw_env->leaves.decay_centre per block, carried by the snapshot's worldstate.nbt leafDecay
